title: Sharing and taking turns
examples: Teacher, what does it mean to be fair?
When do I get a turn with the red crayon?
Is it okay if I take a toy without asking?

explain.say: Today you will learn about sharing with friends.
Sharing means letting others use your things too.
Fairness means everyone gets a turn or the same amount.
Waiting for your turn can feel hard. Waiting is part of taking turns.
Kindness means thinking about how others feel.
You are building a tower with a friend. Your friend adds a block. Then you add a block.

items: You wait for the next turn

faq.q: Why is it important to take turns?
faq.a: Taking turns makes sure everyone gets a chance to play and have fun. It shows you care about your friends.
asks: Why should I wait my turn?

faq.q: What does 'fair' mean when we play games?
faq.a: Fair means that everyone follows the same rules and gets a chance to do things. It means treating everyone equally.
asks: How do I know if something is fair?

faq.q: Can kindness help when I want a toy right now?
faq.a: Yes, being kind means you can ask nicely or wait patiently. It makes your friend feel good.
asks: How can I be kind when I want something?
Is waiting a kind thing to do?

faq.q: If I share my crayons, do I have to share them forever?
faq.a: No, sharing means letting others use them for a little while. You can use them again later too.
asks: Does sharing mean I lose them?
Can I use my things again?

faq.q: What if my friend doesn't want to share?
faq.a: You can ask kindly for a turn. A grown-up can help too.
asks: Who do I tell if they won't share?

facts: Sharing toys makes playtime more fun for everyone.
Fairness means everyone gets a turn when playing games.
Waiting shows that you are patient and kind to your friends.
Kindness is using gentle words and actions with others.

quiz.say: Your friend is using the red truck. You want to play with it. What can you do?

options.show: ask for a turn and wait
options.say: ask for a turn and wait

quiz.why: Asking and waiting gives your friend time to finish their turn.

wrong.1: Taking it without asking can upset your friend.

quiz.say: You and your friend both want the blocks. What is fair?

options.show: a grown-up gives you all of them
options.say: a grown-up gives you all of them

quiz.why: Taking turns means you both get a chance to build.

wrong.0: Keeping them all leaves your friend with nothing to build.
wrong.2: Having all of them leaves your friend out.

quiz.say: Your friend bumps your tower by accident. It falls. What is kind to say?

options.show: That is okay. We can fix it.
options.say: That is okay. We can fix it.

quiz.why: Kind words show it was an accident and you are still friends.

wrong.0: Calling names can hurt your friend's feelings.
wrong.1: Go away can make your friend feel left out.
